events.summary: A fire broke out at the Rumaila field in Basra governorate on 24 January 2025. Basra Oil Company gave technical reasons not yet clarified.

events.summary: On the afternoon of 11 August 2025 the national grid collapsed during extreme heat: the Ministry of Electricity said the system lost more than 6,000 MW at once under high loads, generating units tripped and the system went into total blackout across the centre and south.
events.effect: Ministry of Electricity, as carried by Asharq News and Arabi21: the grid lost more than 6,000 MW suddenly and accidentally, leading to a complete blackout; the ministry said it was working under full emergency footing. Media and local sources reported loss of power in Basra, Maysan, Dhi Qar, Wasit, Baghdad, Diyala, Anbar and Kirkuk.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 5 (grid event; operator emergency and stated scale): the ministry reported "خسارة الشبكة أكثر من 6 آلاف ميغاواط بشكل مفاجئ وعرضي", a total blackout, and that it was working "بحالة الطوارئ الكاملة". No customer count is stated and megawatts are not converted to customers.

capacity_affected.source_says: خسارة الشبكة أكثر من 6 آلاف ميغاواط بشكل مفاجئ وعرضي

events.summary: Production at the West Qurna 2 field in Basra governorate was halted on 8 December 2025 after a reported leak, according to oil ministry and Basra Oil Company sources.
events.effect: Two sources, one at the oil ministry and one at Basra Oil Company, told Rudaw that production at the field, which was producing roughly 480,000 barrels a day, was halted (Rudaw, 8 December 2025); Attaqa reported the same halt and volume the same day and said the ministry did not answer a request for comment. The same Rudaw report relayed Reuters, citing two Iraqi energy officials, that output was restored after a brief outage.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 7: production shut in at a reported volume, about 480,000 barrels a day ('تعطّل ضخّ ما يقارب 480 ألف برميل يوميًا').
